bot_token.description: Telegram bot token (BotFather). Deprecated, removed in 0.63.0: name a grant in bot_token_grant_id instead (#801).

bot_token_grant_id.description: The grant under which the vault delivers the bot token sealed (GH #1059, #801). Set, `bot_token` is ignored and the cell polls only once the box is opened. Never empty here: an empty grant beside an empty `bot_token` is refused at parse. Immutable.

long_poll_request_secs.description: Telegram-side getUpdates long-poll wait in seconds

messages.description: messages is not required at the substrate (GH #1061): the sealed credential box reaches this cell with body.sealed alone, and a required key here would refuse it at delivery as consumes_violation; the cell itself still refuses a send without it.

chat_id.description: chat_id is not required at the substrate (GH #1061): the sealed credential box reaches this cell with body.sealed alone, and a required key here would refuse it at delivery as consumes_violation; the cell itself still refuses a send without it.

description.purpose: Telegram delivery sink for the digest: takes the last assistant turn and sends it to context.chat_id. Inbound user messages to the digest bot are not part of this design: they leave via emit_to to ./void, the silent terminal that emits nothing. Nothing here dead-letters -- /colony/dead_letters is the READ endpoint, never a discard.
description.use_when: As the terminal cell of a push pipeline (no inbound conversation expected).
description.not_in_scope: No conversation handling, no command parsing — this proxy is delivery-only by topology.
description.emits_meaning: Nothing into the pipeline by design (pure sink; inbound user messages leave via emit_to to the silent ./void terminal - S1 addendum: /colony/dead_letters is the READ endpoint, not a discard).
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: last assistant turn is sent. context.chat_id (number) selects the chat — promoted from the format cell's hop.
